gpu_tip: ~22GB total at 128K context, ~11GB of it KV cache, since all 40 of Granite's layers use full attention. Fits entirely on a 24GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4090 or RTX 3090) with no CPU offload; on a 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060 Ti 16GB) llama.cpp's layer offloading runs the last few layers from DDR5 system RAM.
mac_tip: Needs ~22GB — fits a 24GB MacBook Pro (M4, M4 Pro, M5, or M5 Pro), though it's close to the limit; a 32GB configuration leaves more headroom.
